scripts.dev: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace shu-desktop
scripts.build: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace shu-desktop
scripts.package: cargo build --release && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck && npm run package --workspace shu-desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/terminal && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/files
